worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.summary: A breakable bone flies toward the release-time turning point, then directly toward your current catch position. Each direction hits only the first enemy actually contacted. Sidestepping changes the return line; walls break the bone, and catching adds no damage.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.use.0: Throw from mid range, hitting on the way out and back
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.use.1: Let the looping second pass cover the first one's gap
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.use.2: Throw before the target repositions and force it off its spot
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.description: The bone flies at %2$s blocks per tick out to %3$s blocks, dealing about %1$s Ground damage on the way out; the target's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
Return power %1$s, contact radius %2$s blocks; catch within %3$s blocks of your body. Outward overshoot %4$s and sideways bow %5$s both stay within the throw budget.
The bone has %1$s durability; if it shatters or times out it drops where it falls.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.arc.on: Arcing Loop: it flies further past, bows further to the side and slower, with the outbound pass 15 percent lighter and the return 20 percent heavier on a longer cooldown: a heavier but harder-to-land loop.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.arc.off: Straight Out and Back: faster, flatter, both passes even and a shorter cooldown: steadier, but no return bonus.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.growth.0: From level %1$s the outbound pass rises to %2$s and the return to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.growth.1: From level %1$s the outbound pass rises to %2$s, the return to %3$s and the throw range to %4$s blocks.
On: past distance x1.5, loop bow 1.0 blocks, flight speed x0.82, throw range x1.15, outbound x0.85, return x1.2, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (Straight Out and Back): bow 0.3 blocks, both passes and cooldown normal.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values open from further out.
Closer than this it stops throwing and hands over to shared melee. A larger value leaves close-range turns to other moves more often.
world_combat.move.bonemerang.text.miss: The bone flies through empty air
worldcombat.skill.bonemerang.description: The return tracks your present hand position, so sidestepping can sweep it into another enemy. Walls break the bone; catching only retrieves it.
